theme_strategy: Dark Mode Default (Tactical Minimalism for Gaming)

grids_and_layouts.strategy: Collapsible Sidebar + High Density Bento Grid
grids_and_layouts.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar (w-64) for Game List management. Hidden on mobile, accessible via hamburger. Minimalist item rows with active states.
grids_and_layouts.cards: Flat solid surfaces. Avoid heavy drop shadows. Use 1px solid stroke (border-border) with subtle inner glow (shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)]). No fully transparent backgrounds.

component_guidelines.task_list: Dense, F-pattern layout. Continuous list with border-b separators. Large hit-area checkboxes. Include a discrete 'external link' icon aligned right for opening the game.
component_guidelines.buttons: Sharp edges or minimal radius (rounded-md). Primary buttons use vibrant accent. 'Uncheck All' should be a secondary/outline button to avoid accidental clicks.
component_guidelines.charts: Shadcn Chart (Recharts). Bar charts for weekly completion (monochrome bars with accent color for today). Line charts for monthly trends. Hide grid lines for minimalism.
component_guidelines.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select. Custom time picker for 'Daily Reset Time'. Settings modal for toggling browser notifications.
component_guidelines.tabs: Override standard Shadcn tabs. Use clean underline styles or stark pill shapes for switching between 'Tasks', 'History', 'Settings'.

motion.interactions: Hover states must explicitly set text color (e.g., hover:bg-neutral-800 hover:text-white). Focus states must have high contrast rings.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., transition-colors duration-200). DO NOT use 'transition: all'.
motion.checkbox: Subtle scale bump on check. Strikethrough text animation for completed tasks.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA contrast. Text must be readable. Hover states must be lighter than active states.
accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements must have a data-testid (e.g., 'game-item', 'task-checkbox', 'uncheck-all-btn', 'reset-time-input').

visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react. Keep stroke width to 1.5 for a sophisticated look.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: No blank charts. Display stylized ASCII art or stark typography like 'No tasks deployed.' with a clear CTA to add a game.

instructions_to_main_agent: Develop exclusively in .js / .jsx using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI primitives.
Ensure 'Dark Mode' is the default and structurally sound (use exact hex codes provided or map them to Tailwind config).
Implement the daily reset logic visually. If relying on a mock backend, simulate the timer and reset functionality clearly.
Do not use Generic Slop. Avoid standard SaaS Blue. Follow the 'Performance Pro' archetype.
Build the History view with comprehensive tables and Recharts for Monthly/Weekly stats. Include a bold 'Delete History' zone.
For the 'Open Game Link', ensure target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle borders.
Use sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'Tasks Reset', 'Game Added').
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
NEVER use placeholder images or text. Since user generates data, rely on typography and empty states.
